sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Telford Town on Saturday for a 15:00 kick-off. Sandbach sit top of the table with 31 points from 15 games, though they have won just one of their last two league matches after dropping points in recent outings. Telford Town are among the division's struggling sides with only 7 points, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be favoured to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with second-placed Stafford Town (29 points) hosting AFC Bridgnorth in a clash between two high-performing sides, while third-placed Eccleshall (28 points) visit New Mills. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 28 points, face Foley Meir at home looking to maintain their excellent recent form of five consecutive wins. In-form Bilston Town (sixth, 26 points) host Cheadle Heath Nomads, while Barnton welcome Market Drayton Town and Allscott Heath face Wednesfield Community in a fixture between mid-table sides. Elsewhere, Crewe play host to Dawley Town, Alsager Town travel to face Widnes Town (two of the division's lowest-placed teams), Brereton Social welcome Shawbury United, and Shawbury United host Brereton Social.
